reader.requirement: At --std 85 a file-name may head only one SELECT clause of the FILE-CONTROL paragraph of a program, and every file-name a SELECT clause names must have a file description entry (FD, or SD for a sort-merge file) in the Data Division of that same program, not of a containing or contained program; the witness covers only the legal pairing per program in a nested pair.
reader.edition-search: Read BindFileControl's SelectedFiles duplicate check (COBOL2634) and ScreenSelectsHaveDescriptions (COBOL2635); neither reads Edition.Edition, DialectLevel, ConstructRegistry or a version table (the only gate is the class-definition 'screened' flag, not an edition); grep 'FileNameSelectedTwice|SelectWithoutFileDescription' over src finds no edition test.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the per-program legal pairing is exercised; the refusals (a second SELECT, a SELECT with no FD, no FILE SECTION at all, the FD only in a contained program) are not

probes.printed: error COBOL2634: file-name 'F1' is specified in a second SELECT clause
probes.expected: refused: F1 specified twice in FILE-CONTROL

probes.printed: error COBOL2635: file 'F2' is specified in a SELECT clause but has no file description entry (FD) or sort-merge file description entry (SD)
error COBOL2635: file 'F1' ... has no file description entry
probes.expected: refused: degenerate form, no FILE SECTION

probes.printed: COBOL2635 at the outer SELECT F1; COBOL2636 at the contained program's FD F1
probes.expected: refused: the FD is not in the Data Division of the same program

probes.printed: COBOL4250 the file-name 'F1' is described a second time ... ; COBOL4250 for SD S1

probes.expected: a contained program with its own SELECT G1/FD G1 uses the containing program's GLOBAL F1 with no SELECT of its own: legal, compiles and runs

citations.check: OK  §1985:VII.2.3.3 SR2  (2.3.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR2

reader.notes: Both halves are enforced per program at every edition through one code path. The messages cite the 2023 clause (§2023:12.4.5.2 SR2/SR3) at --std 85, a citation-wording point rather than a behaviour fault.

refuter.evidence: Probes (--std 85): E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/coderead-1985/out/refute-1985-062/p2_inner_select_global-001: outer FD F1 IS GLOBAL, contained program writes SELECT F1 with no FD of its own -> COBOL2635 (refused: the FD is not in the same program); E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/coderead-1985/out/refute-1985-062/p2_both_select-001: outer and contained program each SELECT F1 with their own FD -> compiles, each program reads its own file (INNER READ INNER / OUTER READ OUTER); E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/coderead-1985/out/refute-1985-062/p2_sd_twice-001: an SD file named in two SELECT clauses -> COBOL2634. cite.py: OK §1985:VII.2.3.3 SR2 the text is in SR2.
